body.statement: Proposition 2.3 of \cite{ZhangLiMiaoTchetgen2023} treats a linear functional of the solution set of an outcome-bridge operator equation and uses the corresponding null-space annihilation condition to characterize invariance over that solution set; it does not construct simultaneous perturbations of finite full-data causal laws for a treatment network.

attestation.note: The stable primary-preprint handle and proposition locator support the stated solution-set scope comparison.
